post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees.
post.judgeRationale: The PR title references "AI統合開発パイプライン" (AI integrated development pipeline) as the main organizing theme, but the diff only adds a descriptive section to a markdown file documenting this pipeline rather than modifying any code that implements it.
